usage.outputShape: body.data[] (array of {title, url, description, content}); pagination/usage in body.meta {total, limit, offset, credits_used, cached}
quirks: Registry lists method=POST but the endpoint REQUIRES GET — POST returns 405 'Use GET for /api/v1/surf/search/web' (no payment).

The query parameter is named `q` (not `query`/`text`); it is a URL query-string param, not a JSON body. Wrong/missing param returns 400 'Missing required parameters ... requires: q. Payment was NOT charged.'
On 400/405 errors no USDC is settled (txHash null, confirmed false) even if the pay tool reports a quote — only the 200 GET actually charged.
Actual charge was $0.0075, higher than the registry priceDisplay of $0.0050.
usage.guide: Call GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/surf/search/web with a single URL query parameter `q` set to your search terms (URL-encoded), e.g. ?q=latest%20AI%20news. Do NOT use POST and do NOT name the param `query` — both fail without charging. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, no API key. Read results from body.data[], an array of {title, url, description, content}; body.meta gives total/credits. Cost is ~$0.0075 per call.
